examples.arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد الجدة في البيت
examples.english: Today is grandmother's birthday at home.
examples.transliteration: Al-yawm eid milad al-jaddah fi al-bayt.

examples.arabic: وصلت العائلة الكبيرة الى بيت الجدة لتناول طعام العشاء
examples.english: The large family arrived at Grandmother's house for dinner.
examples.transliteration: Wasalat al-ailat al-kabira ila bayt al-jaddah litanawul ta'am al-asha'

examples.arabic: اليوم ذهبت الجدة وحفيدتها الى السوق المحلي
examples.english: Today, the grandmother and her granddaughter went to the local market.
examples.transliteration: Al-yawma dhahabat al-jaddatu wa-ḥafīdatuhā ilā as-sūqi al-maḥallī.

examples.arabic: الجدة قالت طبخنا زمان كان بسيطا ولذيذا
examples.english: The grandmother said our cooking long ago was simple and delicious.
examples.transliteration: Al-jaddatu qalat tabkhuna zaman kana basitan wa ladhidan.
examples.storyTitle: The New Dish and the Grandmother

examples.arabic: فاجابت الجدة ان ذلك يبني التكافل الاجتماعي ويقوي روابط الأسرة كلها
examples.english: The grandmother replied that this builds social solidarity and strengthens all family bonds
examples.transliteration: Fa-ajaabat al-jaddatu anna dhaalika yabni at-takāfula al-ijtimā'iyya wa yuqawwi rawaabita al-usrah kullihaa
